verdict.rationale: Channel3 is an agent-facing commerce and product-catalog API, so an agent wallet is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no user-provisioned, user-funded wallet that an agent holds and spends from, and no balance visibility. The only payment evidence is that agents can pay Channel3 for its own API usage via MPP without an API key. That is an adjacent payment rail, not a wallet the user funds and controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can provision a wallet my agent holds and spends from — funded and controlled by me, with balance visibility
